steps.what: Define the research case, funding fit, methods and resource requirements
Write grant proposals from the research brief and source material

loop.purpose: Draft narrative sections without changing the proposed research
loop.input: Teacher brief, verified sources and call section requirements
loop.output: Sectioned draft with source references and explicit gaps
loop.check: Teacher checks scientific meaning, novelty claims, methods, feasibility and source support against the brief and originals
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported claims, confidential material or unclear methods return the section to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates arrange sections but cannot express a specific research argument

steps.what: Review the final grant proposal for accuracy, coherence and funding requirements

tasks.design: Start with native {DOCS} proposal templates and call checklists. A bounded drafting loop may express the teacher's research brief, while scientific design, factual verification and final teacher review remain counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Call-specific prose is repeatedly assembled from research plans and verified credentials.
tasks.enabler_now: A constrained drafting tool can work from a supplied source pack.
tasks.still_hard: Establishing novelty, feasible methods and credible resource commitments.
tasks.human_edge: Develop the research contribution and defend its feasibility.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft prose work, with research and funding responsibility unchanged.

reach.task: Check funding eligibility and institutional commitments

evidence.claim: A supplied-brief drafting loop may reduce first-draft prose work; no measured grant-writing result is established by this digest.

assumptions: Boundary is the teacher's grant writing and internal review handoff, excluding scientific research, institutional approval and external submission.

Teacher produces call identifier, section requirements, research questions, methods, milestones, verified citations and resource estimates in s1 at full45 hours. Missing fields remain manual research and writing; they are never inferred.

Research support staff retain existing eligibility and budget review; no new structured extraction is transferred to them. Teacher pack preparation and model-output checking are included in retained time.
Use native templates first. The loop is optional only in an approved environment with permitted source material; prohibited or confidential uploads revert to manual writing.
The teacher approves the exact final draft; institutional approvals are not replaced.
unknowns: Funding call rules for drafting assistance
research_questions: Does a blinded comparison preserve research meaning and factual support after all teacher corrections are timed?

already_counted.description: Define research and capture the complete verified brief
Check generated meaning and correct unsupported prose
Final teacher review and internal handoff

incremental.description: Maintain call checklists and review recurring drafting errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact proposal version including research claims, methods, citations and resource estimates; edits void teacher approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R82.5 gross17.5 minus3 upkeep =14.5 net E1. High requires substantial prose assembly from a settled brief; low covers novel methods, extensive corrections or manual-only calls.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce first-draft proposal assembly while retaining research design and accountable claims.
reach: Work with research support on eligible and feasible proposals
role.ambitious_version: A researcher who spends less time assembling prose and preserves time for the research case.
